question: In a code, LEARNERS is written as OHDUQHUV. What is the code for TEACHERS?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

The logic followed here is that each letter is shifted by 3 positions forward (+3 pattern) in the alphabetical series.

**For LEARNERS : OHDUQHUV**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2fb50b767546f91400021359c38153de886e5a4ddce12df2db1bfe3316fe8f5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80911b1f9105fadeb1ca7e0e2c6d1b4e540a64d7224119179721c8d8c6c7c37a.png] 

**Applying the same logic to TEACHERS : ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94c10f3460298c25ed407b134614f6e339f30e4c083d1bcdc2d189335f563023.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/332f0b279f108716e84826ad1ef2979098c5ecbbd733572ff3dc37677d999125.png] 

The resulting code is **WHDFKHUV**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
